role: XCTest suite for JSON key-order determinism: three tests pin Foundation's .sortedKeys contract on local structs, and two are the regression net for the provider request encoders, building requests through AnthropicProvider.makeRequest and OpenAICompatibleStreamer.requestFor and failing if either stops encoding with .sortedKeys (GeminiProvider.makeRequest is private and not covered).
types: JSONOrderingTests.Payload: struct — local Encodable test payload

units.does: Encodes a local Payload 100 times with a .sortedKeys JSONEncoder and asserts exactly one distinct Data.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: encodes and inserts into a Set

units.does: Encodes the payload once without .sortedKeys and only asserts the UTF-8 string is non-empty.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: fallback empty string when the data is not UTF-8, which fails the non-empty assertion

units.does: Encodes a local CacheControl(type:'ephemeral', ttl:'1h') 100 times with .sortedKeys and asserts one distinct Data.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: encodes and inserts into a Set

units.does: Builds an AnthropicProvider.RequestBody (cacheAwareSystemBlocks('rules'), one plain user message, stream, no tools), sends it through AnthropicProvider.makeRequest, and asserts the request's httpBody equals a local .sortedKeys encoding of the body; a control asserts the plain (declaration-order) encoding differs, so the comparison can fail.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Builds a DeepSeek StreamCall and its request through OpenAICompatibleStreamer.requestFor, finds the first '"messages":', '"model":', '"stream":' and '"stream_options":' in the body text (decoded as UTF-8; the test fails if it is not), and asserts messages precedes model and stream precedes stream_options, the reverse of the private body's declaration order (model, messages, stream, stream_options), i.e. the body was encoded with .sortedKeys.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass
